name: snowflake-sql-sql-dialect-fmt
description: Local Snowflake and Databricks SQL formatting, syntax highlighting, and optional LSP diagnostics, hover, and completion.

sqlDialectFmt.dialect.markdownDescription: SQL dialect used when formatting `snowflake-sql` documents.

sqlDialectFmt.lineWidth.description: Target line width the formatter tries to stay within before wrapping.

sqlDialectFmt.indentWidth.description: Number of spaces per indentation level.

enumDescriptions: Write recognized SQL keywords in upper case.
Write recognized SQL keywords in lower case.
Keep each recognized keyword's source spelling.
sqlDialectFmt.keywordCase.description: Letter case used for recognized SQL keywords.

sqlDialectFmt.selectItemLayout.markdownDescription: Use `vertical` for one top-level SELECT item per line, or `auto` to keep short lists inline and wrap at `lineWidth`.

sqlDialectFmt.commaStyle.description: Place commas after the preceding item or before the following item when a list wraps.

sqlDialectFmt.lineEnding.description: Output line endings. Auto preserves the first line ending found in the document.

sqlDialectFmt.useEditorIndentation.markdownDescription: Use the active editor's `editor.tabSize` for indentation. Disable to use `sqlDialectFmt.indentWidth`.

sqlDialectFmt.lsp.enabled.markdownDescription: Opt in to the `sql-dialect-fmt-lsp` language server for diagnostics, hover, completion, semantic tokens, document symbols, folding, and on-type formatting (install it with `cargo install sql-dialect-fmt-lsp`). When the server is running it also takes over formatting; when the binary is missing the extension silently falls back to the bundled WebAssembly formatter.

sqlDialectFmt.lsp.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `sql-dialect-fmt-lsp` executable. Leave empty to look it up on `PATH`.

sqlDialectFmt.lint.markdownDescription: Lint diagnostic toggles forwarded to the `sql-dialect-fmt-lsp` language server, e.g. `{ "enabled": true, "selectWildcard": false, "largeInListThreshold": 32 }`. Only used while the LSP client is enabled and running.
